newsitem.title: UK: BA down as Merrill repeats "neutral" rating.
newsitem.headline: BA down as Merrill repeats "neutral" rating.

text.p: Shares in British Airways Plc dipped as analysts at Merrill Lynch repeated a "neutral" rating on the stock and said it was "due a rest" after its recent sharp rise, traders said.
The stock -- up 167p in the six sessions starting September 30 -- was down 6p at 586 by 1338 GMT.

Merrill analysts said rising fuel prices could overshadow BA shares in the short term, yet there was still scope for gains in the medium term on the back of hopes for its planned alliance with American Airlines, sources said.
They set a 660p medium-term objective for the stock. Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment. -- David Holmes, London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
